name: @dsh-local/web-search-searxng
description: SearXNG-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web). Replaces Exa as the web_search backend with the self-hosted SearXNG instance. v0.2: pure-function core (lib/core.js) for inline operator parsing (lang:/engines:/fresh:/pageno:), CJK-based language/engine routing, junk-domain filtering, canonical-URL dedupe, snippet decoration, 2-page pagination and a zero-result engines fallback.
